itemUsage.en: Newly-appointed Sniper Operator Orchid, calmly taking on all trouble blocking her way.
itemUsage.zh: 新晋狙击干员梓兰，冷静地面对一切麻烦。

itemDesc.en: Do you believe her earnest explanation that it's just a change of clothes, and nothing more?
itemDesc.zh: 她很认真地解释，她只是换了身衣服，并没有什么其他的变化，你相信吗？

description.en:
Looses 4 arrows for <@ba.vup>{atk_scale_1:0%}</> ATK each
<@ba.rem>Can store 1 charge; uses 1 charge automatically when charges are full</>
description.zh: 发射4支攻击力<@ba.vup>{atk_scale_1:0%}</>的箭矢\n<@ba.rem>可充能1次，充能至最大层数时自动释放一次</>

description.en:
Looses 4 arrows for <@ba.vup>{atk_scale_1:0%}</> ATK each; if there are still charges available, consumes 1 charge to perform <@ba.vup>Power Volley</>: looses 5 arrows for <@ba.vup>{atk_scale_2:0%}</> ATK each, and each arrow has a <@ba.vup>{stun_prob:0%}</> chance to <$ba.stun>Stun</> the target for <@ba.vup>{stun}</>s
<@ba.rem>Can store 2 charges; uses 1 charge automatically when charges are full</>
description.zh: 发射4支攻击力<@ba.vup>{atk_scale_1:0%}</>的箭矢，若还有充能则额外消耗1层施展<@ba.vup>刚连射</>：发射5支攻击力<@ba.vup>{atk_scale_2:0%}</>的箭矢，每支箭矢有<@ba.vup>{stun_prob:0%}</>概率使目标<$ba.stun>晕眩</><@ba.vup>{stun}</>秒\n<@ba.rem>可充能2次，充能至最大层数时自动释放一次</>

description.en:
<$ba.liftoff>Takes Off</> shooting 3 volleys at all enemies ahead, each volley loosing 3, 4, then 5 arrows for <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale_loop:0%}</> ATK each; after landing, deals <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale_end:0%}</> ATK as Physical damage to all enemies in a small area ahead
<@ba.rem>Can store 1 charge; immediately uses one charge after deployment</>
description.zh: 立刻<$ba.liftoff>起飞</>并对前方范围的所有目标射击3次，分别射出3、4、5支攻击力提升至<@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale_loop:0%}</>的箭矢；之后降落并对前方小范围内的所有敌人造成攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale_end:0%}</>的物理伤害\n<@ba.rem>可充能1次，部署后立即释放一次</>

description.en:
After charging for <@ba.vup>3s</>, unleashes a piercing arrow that flies in a straight line forward, <@ba.vup>moderately</> pushing every enemy it passes through and dealing <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Physical damage and <@ba.vup>{atk_scale_magic:0%}</> ATK as Arts damage to all surrounding enemies every time the arrow travels a set distance; arrows have unlimited range
<@ba.rem>Can store 1 charge</>
description.zh: 蓄力<@ba.vup>3</>秒后射出直线飞行的贯穿箭矢，箭矢以<@ba.vup>中等力度</>推动每个经过的敌人，每飞行一段距离都会对周围所有敌人造成攻击力<@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</>的物理伤害和攻击力<@ba.vup>{atk_scale_magic:0%}</>的法术伤害，箭矢射程无限\n<@ba.rem>可充能1次</>

description.en:
Outfitted with a custom-craft kit, Operator Orchid has demonstrated a remarkable aptitude for inflicting physical casualties with precision on enemies at close range.
The Field Operations Department has thus passed the following resolution:
This operator shall be appointed a Sniper Operator during field operations to exercise Heavyshooter responsibilities.
In witness whereof,
This badge is hereby conferred upon the above named.

description.en:
Orchid goes to a corner of the training ground, where she has several targets set up for her own exclusive use—not that she had forbidden anyone else from using them, just that they look so unique that everyone assumed so.
She has just completed the debriefing of yet another headache-inducing A6 mission. Catapult had gone off on her own again, and Spot's report consisted of storyboards for the comic he is working on, while Midnight tried to get out of it by submitting bar vouchers as a bribe. The familiar sense of annoyance rushes in like the tide.
Orchid takes a deep breath and draws her bow.
It is not a beast she is hunting, but the chaos inside her.
Her sojourn in Houei has not changed her everyday life in the slightest, and a momentary change in mindset cannot quell the anger brought about by real life.
An arrow finds Spot's chest with unerring accuracy as she recalls his lazy face and that sorry excuse of a report he submitted.
Another arrow pierces Midnight's collar as she recalls the stinging scent of the perfume and his lame excuses.
One arrow after another finds the next target until it is barely recognizable. Her breath quickens as she recalls Catapult's frenzied excitement in their most recent battle.
Finally, her gaze falls upon the last target, Popukar. Orchid draws her bow and aims.
Popukar has always been Orchid's biggest headache. She stubbornly believes that A6 will be around forever, a belief that has not changed even as she grew up.
That unshakable resolve sometimes gives Orchid the daunting thought that she might have to deal with the problem children of A6 for the rest of her life.
She gazes at Popukar for a long time before taking a deep breath and calming herself down.
She had never done something like this before, preferring to yell at them directly. But now, she has realized that they will never change, no matter how much she yells at them, and she will always end up having to deal with her anger on her own.
So she decided to try something different after coming back from Houei. To her surprise, she found no opposition from the members of A6. In fact, they began to tease each other based on which targets she had taken the most shots at. For her own part, she finds that taking these shots gives her a different perspective.
Rather than yelling at Spot, she decides to hold off on providing feedback on his report. He will eventually get impatient and come to her.
She decides to pretend to believe Midnight's crap, and see how he reacts when she actually does what he says.
As for Catapult... Orchid is forced to admit that she does not dislike who Catapult is now. Her only option is to hone her own skills—either to stop Catapult from doing anything dangerous... or to help her. Orchid sighs. She is quite reluctant to admit what she is thinking.
And then there is Popukar. How could it ever be Popukar's fault? Orchid is already thinking about the new outfits she will make for the girl.
She puts down her bow, feeling happier already.
After letting off steam, it is as though a weight has been lifted from her mind.
She begins to believe that perhaps things are not as complicated as she thought.
description.zh:
梓兰来到训练场的角落，她在这里竖起了几个她专用的靶子——好吧，她其实没说过别人不能用，但大家认为就是她专用的，毕竟，这些靶子的造型太过特别。
梓兰刚结束了一次令人头疼的A6任务复盘。空爆又擅自行动了，斑点提交的报告画满了他新漫画的分镜草稿，而月见夜则试图用几张酒吧优惠券来蒙混过关。她感到那种熟悉的心烦像潮水一样涌来。
梓兰深吸一口气，拉开了弓。
对她来说，她的狩猎对象，并不是野兽，而是混乱。
显而易见的是，从泡影国归来没有让她的生活发生任何改变，某个瞬间的心态变化也并不能平息现实带来的怒火。
唰。箭矢精准地钉在斑点的胸口。她想起了那份潦草的报告和那家伙懒洋洋的脸。
唰。箭矢戳破了月见夜的衣领。她想起了那股刺鼻的香水味和他那套敷衍的说辞。
唰、唰、唰。她想起了空爆在战斗中那近乎自毁的兴奋。她的呼吸变得急促，箭矢接二连三地飞出，直到那个靶子上插满了箭。
随后，她的视线落在最后一个靶子上。泡普卡。梓兰拉开弓，瞄准了它。
泡普卡一直是她最头疼的孩子。因为，泡普卡执拗地相信，A6必然会永远存在，这一点完全没有随着其年龄的增长发生任何改变。
有的时候，泡普卡的坚定会让她产生自己要被A6这些烦恼纠缠一辈子的恐慌感。
不过，她凝视了泡普卡许久，最终，深呼吸了一次，平静下来。
过去她从未做过这样的事——她会直接发脾气，但是，她知道自己发脾气没有用，这帮人并不会改，最终，她只能独自消化。
但从泡影国回来后，她决定尝试一下新方法，然后，她惊讶地发现，A6的队员们并没有对此有什么不满，他们甚至开始拿她今天有没有对彼此的靶子射箭来互相调侃。而对她来说，每次这么做之后，她的心中都会有一些想法。
她打算不去骂斑点，而是暂时搁置对他报告的评价，等他自己憋不住了来问。
她决定假装相信月见夜的鬼话，看看如果自己按照他说的去做，这家伙会有什么反应。
至于空爆，好吧，她必须承认，她其实并不讨厌现在的空爆，如果说自己真的能做些什么，那或许只有磨练技艺，以便在未来阻止她做危险的事，或者……帮助她？梓兰叹了口气，她实在不愿意承认自己在想这样的事。
而泡普卡，唉，泡普卡又能有什么错呢！她已经在想该给泡普卡的新衣服做什么设计了。
这么想着，她愉快地放下了弓箭。
是的，在怨气被发散出去后，她感觉自己也变得轻盈了。
她逐渐开始相信——有些事好像确实没有自己过去想的那么复杂。
